clusters.name: schema-and-detector
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-001 (schema-drift trio + plugin AGENTS.md + package.json test:lib expansion + parser test) and US-002 (pure detector helper + shared fixture) touch zero overlapping files. The detector logic depends only on the OverviewTask shape, which is well-documented in the research brief, so it can be implemented in parallel with the schema files. Drift-check test (validate-data.test.ts) is the safety net at convergence.

clusters.name: emitters
clusters.executionModeRationale: Single-story cluster. The 3 emitter changes plus the derived-artifacts audit are independent of each other within this PRD and a single implementer agent can handle all. Depends on schema-and-detector for both the field's existence in types and the shared detector helper as the import. Risk is medium because the score-recommendations.mjs return-shape change is consumer-visible (wrapped as { topRecommendations, unblockCandidates }) — emit-snapshot.mjs must accept both shapes for back-compat.

clusters.name: mcp-and-viewer
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-004 (MCP tool + shared title helper extraction) and US-005 (viewer chip + App.tsx tasksById memoization) share zero files. The MCP tool refactor for the shared task-title helper touches parallel-ready-tasks.ts but is structural (extraction, not behavioral); MCP reads from snapshot (already produced by emitters cluster); viewer computes client-side from OverviewData via the shared fixture. Independent surfaces; can run in parallel safely. The validate-data drift-check passes once schema-and-detector lands.

clusters.name: backfill-and-impl-release
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-006 (advisory backfill report), US-007 (impl-side release prep: CHANGELOG + version bumps to topic branch), and US-008 (lead-handoff report) are file-disjoint. Recommend serial: US-006 -> US-007 -> US-008 because US-008 references US-007's concrete topic-branch SHA in the lead-handoff. US-007 is the LAST step that modifies plugin files; US-008 is a pure deliverable write. NEITHER cluster touches codexu repo (lead-owned per F-001/F-005 fix); NEITHER pushes toolkit main (lead-owned per F-001/F-005 fix). Implementer ends on a pushed topic branch with an explicit STOP message.
